First release of **actnode**: find GitHub Actions steps still running on Node 20 (or older) and the release that moves each one to Node 24.

- Resolves every `uses:` to the action's real `runs.using` at the pinned ref (tag, version or SHA)
- Follows composite actions, including their local sub-actions
- Suggests the smallest major bump on Node 24, in the same ref style (SHA pins get SHA + `# vX.Y.Z`)
- `--fix` rewrites the lines; `--fail` gates CI; text / JSON / Markdown output
- GitHub Action `Blackman99/actnode@v0.1.0` writes a job-summary table

Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/actnode/docs/
